items.title: Secret Chest Base
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Super secret chest base is hidden within a mansion! Explore the base and find new activities. It includes: 

- Millionaire mansion
- Hidden chest Base
- Multiple rooms
- Various activities
- Multiplayer friendly 
- Survival spawn

And a lot more!

- By Khubeb786

items.title: Underwater Horror
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Horrifying sea monsters have broken out of The Zoo! Find a way to escape, as you uncover clues about what happened to this dystopian underwater city. Watch your stamina, and don't let the monsters get to you!
* Horrifying sea monsters
* Gripping horror story
* Watch your stamina
* A rogue A.I.
- SINGLEPLAYER ONLY

Go out to the beach play volleyball, go swimming or just chill with your friends.

+ Roleplay
+ Summer
+ Teens

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Blue Style
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The new teen style has arrived! Live life like a superstar and innovate the fashion industry by wearing the best blue outfits. Are you ready for this magnificent experience?

+ 10 skins
+ Perfect for roleplaying games 
+ By Arkitex Studios

items.title: Millionaire Island Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Island Mansion is a mansion with everything a millionaire needs! From fun rooms to a beautiful custom yacht, this mansion has tons of stuff for you to share with your friends! Explore your giant house and private island and enjoy all the luxury it has to offer.

- Mega mansion
- Modern design
- Great with friends!

items.title: Alien Invasion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Jump lightyears ahead of the competition with these wacky and unique friends from far-away planets!

- 10 goofy aliens
- Simple, aesthetic designs
- By thiccsnail

items.title: Teens Ahoy
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Ahoy! Ahoy matey! It's a pleasure to see new souls who dare venture out into the seven seas! Welcome aboard lad! There's plenty of treasures to be found!

+ 14 unique role-playing skins
+ Pirate attire inspired by anime and history!

items.title: Summer Vacation
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
You deserved some rest after working hard all year! Enjoy the summer by playing beach ball, swimming or just hanging out with friends.

- 10 summer skins
- By Pixelusion & Bone Block Designs

items.title: Skybirds
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Discover a wonderful world, populated by majestic birds waiting for you to live crazy adventures! The archipelago of the three birds is full of secrets that are yours to discover…

- Dozens of birds species to tame, raise and fly with!
- Tons of objectives to complete alone or with your friends!
- Hidden dungeons to explore and loots to find!
- By Pixelusion & bidule995

items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Your moment to show off has come! Get fashionable with clothes of all flavors and styles!

Stare down your friends with a scary smile!

items.title: Rainbow Axolotl Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
What better way to show off your love for Minecraft than to become the cutest mob ever! With 12 rainbow axolotls that are in the shade of every colour from pastels to neons, you’ll not only look awesome, but you can show off your pride for mobs.

- 12 rainbow skins 
- Includes 1 free skin
- Great for everyone

items.title: Pastel Fashion

+ 2 free skins included

items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Whether if you are a modern teen or an epic hacker, this battle needs your help to finish the fight! With 6 cool teen skins and 6 differently masked hackers, you can choose your dream team and proudly show off it around the city. 

- 6 teen skins
- 6 hacker skins
- Includes 1 free skin

Do you like the city and anime? Then this pack is for you! Put on these anime outfits and travel the city in style.

items.title: Blades Of Heroes
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
An amazing bundle with 20 extraordinary swords is waiting for you! Each sword has special effects with various abilities that will apply to a player that is holding it. However, each sword has its own disadvantages that may kill you! The pack comes with 4-PVP maps where you can fight your friends and try the swords! Get it now!

- Sword Bundle!
- PvP maps!
- By Enigma

items.title: Hunters Vs Werewolves
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you be the hunter or the hunted? Age old foes face off with one another in this skin-pack! Will you take the side of the hunters who see themselves as guardians, keeping ravenous beasts under control? Or will you take the side of the werewolves, who just might be misunderstood creatures?

- 12 skins
- By Geniely
